body:
Your coffee looks unfamiliar. So does the name on the lid.

这是你的吗？
Zhè shì nǐ de ma?
Is this yours?

你的吗 (nǐ de ma) asks whether something belongs to the person you’re speaking to.

Two people reach for the same mug. Both pause, then laugh.

我们换一下吧。
Wǒmen huàn yíxià ba.
Let’s swap.

吧 (ba) makes the suggestion sound softer.

That’s someone else’s backpack in your hand.

我拿错了。
Wǒ ná cuò le.
I took the wrong one.

错 after 拿 tells you the action was a mistake.

The backpack at the station looks just like yours. Before you lift it, ask:

这是我的包吗？
Zhè shì wǒ de bāo ma?
Is this my bag?

我的包 (wǒ de bāo) means “my bag.”
